52010-some-animal-stories.title: Stories*
52010-some-animal-stories.creator: Unknown
52010-some-animal-stories.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. , with an undertone like the fierce protestations of a saw beneath the file, was a summons to his mate, telling her that the hour had come when they should seek their prey. From the lair behind the rock, where the cubs were being suckled by their dam, came no immediate answer.

7526-the-englishwoman-in-america.title: The Englishwoman In America
7526-the-englishwoman-in-america.creator: Isabella Lucy Bird
7526-the-englishwoman-in-america.description: A book by Isabella Lucy Bird. y--A queer character--Politics-- Chemistry--Mathematics--Rotten bridges--A midnight arrival--Colonial ignorance--Yankee conceit--What ten-horse power chaps can do--The pestilence--The city on the rock--New Brunswick--Steamboat peculiarities --Going ahead in the eating line--A storm--Stepping ashore. First experiences of American freedom--The "striped pig" and "Dusty Ben" --A country mouse--What the cars are like--Beauties of New England--The land of apples--A Mammoth hotel--The rusty inkstand exiled--Eloquent eyes --Alone in a crowd.

arxiv-2111-05820.title: Multi-Task Neural Processes
arxiv-2111-05820.creator: Jiayi Shen, Xiantong Zhen, Marcel Worring, Ling Shao
arxiv-2111-05820.description: Abstract Neural processes have recently emerged as a class of powerful neural latent variable models that combine the strengths of neural networks and stochastic processes. As they can encode contextual data in the network’s function space, they offer a new way to model task relatedness in multi-task learning.

arxiv-2304-07286.title: Realizing Majorana Kramers pairs in two-channel InAs-Al nanowires with highly misaligned electric fields
arxiv-2304-07286.creator: Benjamin D. Woods, Mark Friesen
arxiv-2304-07286.description: Abstract Common proposals for realizing topological superconductivity and Majorana zero modes in semiconductor-superconductor hybrids require large magnetic fields, which paradoxically suppress the superconducting gap of the parent superconductor. Although two-channel schemes have been proposed as a way to eliminate magnetic fields, geometric constraints make their implementation challenging, since the channels should be immersed in nearly antiparallel electric fields.

arxiv-2307-01870.title: Exploring Non-Verbal Predicates in Semantic Role Labeling: Challenges and Opportunities
arxiv-2307-01870.creator: Riccardo Orlando, Simone Conia Roberto NavigliSapienza NLP Group, Sapienza University of Rome {orlando,navigli}@diag.uniroma1.itconia@di.uniroma1.it
arxiv-2307-01870.description: Abstract Although we have witnessed impressive progress in Semantic Role Labeling (SRL), most of the research in the area is carried out assuming that the majority of predicates are verbs. Conversely, predicates can also be expressed using other parts of speech, e.g., nouns and adjectives.

arxiv-2312-06338.title: BoschAI @ Causal News Corpus 2023: Robust Cause-Effect Span Extraction using Multi-Layer Sequence Tagging and Data Augmentation
arxiv-2312-06338.creator: Timo Pierre Schrader Simon Razniewski Lukas Lange Annemarie Friedrich
arxiv-2312-06338.description: Abstract Understanding causality is a core aspect of intelligence. The Event Causality Identification with Causal News Corpus Shared Task addresses two aspects of this challenge: Subtask 1 aims at detecting causal relationships in texts, and Subtask 2 requires identifying signal words and the spans that refer to the cause or effect, respectively.

arxiv-2502-15388.title: Modeling Compact Objects in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) Gravity: Application of Buchdahl-I Metric with Chaplygin Equation of State
arxiv-2502-15388.creator: A. Zahra, S. A. Mardan, Muhammad Bilal Riaz, S. Saleem
arxiv-2502-15388.description: Abstract This paper investigates realistic anisotropic matter configurations for spherical symmetry in the framework of f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity. The solutions obtained from Buchdahl-I metric are used to determine the behavior of PSR J0740+6620, PSR J0348+0432 and 4U 1608-52 with Starobinsky model.

arxiv-2506-20753.title: Accelerated Cops and Robbers
arxiv-2506-20753.creator: William B. Kinnersley, Nikolas Townsend
arxiv-2506-20753.description: Abstract . We consider a variant of Cops and Robbers in which both the cops and the robber are allowed to traverse up to s s edges on each of their turns, where s ≥ 2 s\geq 2 . We give several general for this new model as well as establish bounds for the cop numbers for grids and hypercubes.

arxiv-2508-18648.title: Thinking Before You Speak: A Proactive Test-time Scaling Approach
arxiv-2508-18648.creator: Cong Liu, Wenchang Chai, Hejun Wu, Yan Pan, Pengxu Wei, Liang Lin, Sun Yat-sen University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University liucong3@mail.sysu.edu.cn, wenchang.chai@connect.polyu.hk,wuhejun.sysu.edu.cn, panyan5@mail.sysu.edu.cn, weipx3@mail.sysu.edu.cn, linliang@ieee.org
arxiv-2508-18648.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit deficiencies with complex reasoning tasks, such as maths, which we attribute to the discrepancy between human reasoning patterns and those presented in the LLMs’ training data. When dealing with complex problems, humans tend to think carefully before expressing solutions.

plos-pone-0006651.creator: Angela M. Keuling, Kathleen E. A. Felton, Arabesque A. M. Parker et al.
plos-pone-0006651.description: PLOS ONE research article. Malignant melanoma is resistant to almost all conventional forms of chemotherapy. Recent evidence suggests that anti-apoptotic proteins of the Bcl-2 family are overexpressed in melanoma and may contribute to melanoma's striking resistance to apoptosis. ABT-737, a small-molecule i

pmc-10606253.title: A Survey of Deep Learning-Based Multimodal Emotion Recognition: Speech, Text, and Face
pmc-10606253.creator: Hailun Lian, Cheng Lu, Sunan Li, Yan Zhao, Chuangao Tang, Yuan Zong
pmc-10606253.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) refers to the identification and understanding of human emotional states by combining different signals, including—but not limited to—text, speech, and face cues. MER plays a crucial role in the human–computer interaction (HCI) domain. With the recent progression of deep learning technologies and the increasing availability of multimodal datasets, the MER domain has witnessed considerable development, resulting in numerous significant research breakthroughs. However, a conspicuous absence of thorough and focused reviews on these deep learning-based MER achievements is observed.

pmc-10714868.title: Design of a novel affinity probe using the cell wall-binding domain of a Listeria monocytogenes autolysin for pathogen detection
pmc-10714868.creator: Min Lin, Hanhong Dan
pmc-10714868.description: Rapid identification of foods and food-processing environments contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes is crucial for controlling human listeriosis, a leading cause of fatality related to foodborne illnesses. The L. monocytogenes autolysin IspC anchors to the bacterial surface non-covalently via its C-terminal cell wall-binding domain (CWBD), which contains conserved Gly-Trp (GW) dipeptides.

pmc-10824325.title: Vitiligo: Current Therapies and Future Treatments
pmc-10824325.creator: Julien Seneschal, Katia Boniface
pmc-10824325.description: The current management of vitiligo remains challenging; however, different strategies can be proposed to patients with a good efficacy in many cases. First, it is important to identify patients in the active phase of the disease because treatment should start as soon as possible to halt its progression.

pmc-11365043.title: Clinical value of thromboelastography in predicting the risk of recurrence of acute ischemic stroke
pmc-11365043.creator: Ruyue Guo, Xiaoming Shen, Jin Lu, Jiao Zhou, Shinan Hao, Rui Lan, Yumin Xu
pmc-11365043.description: BackgroundThromboelastography (TEG) can objectively reflect the formation, development and rupture process of thrombosis in patients, but there are limited data on whether TEG can be used as a predictive tool for recurrence in patients with acute ischemic stroke.ObjectiveTo explore the TEG risk of recurrence in patients with acute ischemic stroke predictive value.

pmc-11402148.title: Quality deterioration of mashed potatoes during the freeze-thaw cycle: From the perspective of moisture and microstructure
pmc-11402148.creator: Yingying Yu, Wuyin Weng, Zhongyang Ren, Yucang Zhang, Ping Li, Linfan Shi
pmc-11402148.description: This study aimed to simulate cold chain sales temperatures to predict the effects of temperature fluctuations on the physicochemical properties, moisture distribution, microstructure, and flavor of mashed potatoes. The results showed a decline in the hardness and chewability of mashed potatoes alongside the migration of water from bound water states to weakly bound states under freeze-thaw cycles (FTC) conditions.

pmc-11525254.title: Epidemiological and Genetic Insights of the Circulating Foot-and-Mouth Disease Virus Serotypes in Egypt
pmc-11525254.creator: Rabab T Hassanein, Hala K Abdelmegeed, Dina A Abdelwahed, Abeer G Zaki, Alaa S Saad, Momtaz A Shahein, Ahmed F Afify, Mohammed A Rohaim
pmc-11525254.description: Foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) remains a major threat to livestock in Egypt, with ongoing outbreaks involving serotypes A, O, and SAT2. This study aimed to improve the understanding of these circulating FMDV strains to improve control measures. Between 2022 and 2023, 134 cattle samples from across Egypt were analyzed, revealing a 67.9% positivity rate for Pan FMDV.

pmc-11641312.title: Determinants of Government Expenditures with Health Insurance Beneficiaries in the Brazilian Health System
pmc-11641312.creator: Leonardo Moreira, João Vitor Marques Teodoro de Lima, Murilo Mazzotti Silvestrini, Flavia Mori Sarti
pmc-11641312.description: Background/Objectives: The Brazilian health system provides healthcare financed by the public and private sector, being the first designed to encompass universal healthcare coverage delivered to the population without charge to patients (Sistema Único de Saúde, SUS), whilst the second refers to healthcare coverage delivered for individuals with the capacity to pay for assistance through health insurance or out-of-pocket disbursements.

pmc-11657786.title: Genomic analyses revealed low genetic variation in the intron-exon boundary of the doublesex gene within the natural populations of An. gambiae s.l. in Burkina Faso
pmc-11657786.creator: Mahamadi Kientega, Ioanna Morianou, Nouhoun Traoré, Nace Kranjc, Honorine Kaboré, Odette N Zongo, Abdoul-Azize Millogo, Patric Stephane Epopa, Franck A. Yao, Adrien M G Belem, Austin Burt, Abdoulaye Diabaté
pmc-11657786.description: BackgroundThe recent success of a population control gene drive targeting the doublesex gene in Anopheles gambiae paved the way for developing self-sustaining and self-limiting genetic control strategies targeting the sex determination pathway to reduce and/or distort the reproductive capacity of insect vectors.

pmc-12653693.title: Beyond Standard Parameters: Precision Hemodynamic Monitoring in Patients on Veno-Arterial ECMO
pmc-12653693.creator: Debora Emanuela Torre, Carmelo Pirri
pmc-12653693.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Hemodynamic management in veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (V-A ECMO) is inherently complex, as extracorporeal circulation profoundly alters preload, afterload, ventriculo-arterial coupling and tissue perfusion. This review summarizes current and emerging monitoring strategies to guide initiation, maintenance and weaning. Methods: A structured literature search was performed in PubMed and Scopus (1990–2025), including clinical studies, consensus statement and expert reviews addressing hemodynamic monitoring in V-A ECMO. Results: A multiparametric framework is required.

pmc-12721237.title: The activity of pyrazoline B compound in inhibiting proliferation of breast cancer cells with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 overexpression
pmc-12721237.creator: Denny Satria, Syukur Berkat Waruwu, Eti Nurwening Sholikhah, Mustofa Mustofa, Pamungkas Bagus Satriyo, Tutik Dwi Wahyuningsih, Hesti L Wiraswati, Muhammad Hasan Bashari, Ema Damayanti
pmc-12721237.description: IntroductionThis study aimed to evaluate the cytotoxicity and elucidate the mechanism of action of the chemical compound pyrazoline B in inhibiting the proliferation of MCF 7/HER-2 breast cancer cells.Material and methodsPyrazoline B was synthesized at the Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, Universitas Gadjah Mada. Cytotoxic activity against MCF 7/HER-2 cells was assessed using the MTT assay.

pmc-12732967.title: Effect of Ultrasonic Treatment of Dispersed Carbon Nanocomposite Media on the Formation, Electrical Conductivity, and Degradation of a Hydrogel for Metallic Stimulation Electrodes
pmc-12732967.creator: Mikhail Savelyev, Artem Kuksin, Denis Murashko, Ekaterina Otsupko, Victoria Suchkova, Kristina Efremova, Pavel Vasilevsky, Ulyana Kurilova, Sergey Selishchev, Alexander Gerasimenko
pmc-12732967.description: This study investigates the impact of ultrasonic treatment on the deagglomeration of aggregates of single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and reduced graphene oxide (rGO). The aim of the research is to enhance the electrical conductivity of a biopolymer hydrogel designed for coating metallic neurostimulation electrodes.

pmc-13207446.title: Integrating Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation of Oleanolic Acid Targeting the PPARα-CPT1A Axis to Modulate Lipid Metabolism in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cells
pmc-13207446.creator: Yuxin Liu, Deru Zhang, Dan Liu, Mengke Wang, Hanning Lyu, Yang Sun
pmc-13207446.description: Patients with liver cancer frequently exhibit abnormal liver function and disorders in lipid metabolism. This study investigates the effects of Oleanolic acid (OA) on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) through the regulation of lipid metabolism. Computational simulations identified six core targets of OA, including PPARα, HMGCR, and ESR1, with stable binding confirmed through molecular docking and dynamics analyses.

pmc-13298851.title: Beyond the bladder: incontinence-specific, physical, and psychological contributors to sexual function in women with urinary incontinence
pmc-13298851.creator: Nancy Yang, Abigail Shatkin-Margolis, Leslee L Subak, Margaret Chesney, Nadra E Lisha, Michael Schembri, A Lenore Ackerman, Alison J Huang

pmc-13509346.title: The Impact of Psychological Resilience on Digital Transformation: A Resource Orchestration Perspective
pmc-13509346.creator: Gejun Wang, Xingqiu Hu
pmc-13509346.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In the context of economic turbulence, pursuing new development opportunities through digital transformation has become an inevitable choice for Chinese firms, with top executives serving as core decision-makers. Drawing on resource orchestration theory and the too-much-of-a-good-thing effect, this study examines the relationship between executive psychological resilience and enterprise digital transformation, as well as its boundary conditions, using panel data from Chinese A-share listed firms from 2011 to 2024.
